commands.checks: Re-derives from the local Git object store the merge-parent set of 51122344 and each reviewed head's complete three-dot changed-path set with blob identities, compares all of it to RECEIPT.json (identity positive fixture), re-checks SOURCES.json blob and SHA256 pins, and runs seven in-memory rejection controls (corrupted head blob, corrupted merge blob, wrong verdict, dropped path, fabricated path, false changed-head flag, wrong totals) that must all be rejected.
